title: Model Risk Management

maps.tested: Both the guidance reading and the paired case study are rated Very Important. Tested as a framework-application question in a novel organisational setting.
maps.specifics: Reported: 'model risk'; and one specific item: 'friction between investor and rating agency... I chose model error as the answer', which maps model risk onto the securitisation-frictions taxonomy. The three components of model risk management (development/implementation/use, validation, governance) and the independence requirement for validation are the examinable core.

vardeezReading: ORR-15: Very Important. ORR-16: Very Important. ORR-3: untiered, with the note "use crash course notes for ORR-1 to ORR-9; no Schweser needed".

selectors.name: Investor and rating agency friction: model error
selectors.what: In the securitisation frictions taxonomy, the friction between investor and credit rating agency is labelled model error, because the investor relies on the agency's rating model. Tied to the GARP Gaussian copula case: a model valid in normal conditions that was not updated when correlations rose.

selectors.name: Three components of model risk management
selectors.what: The three components of a model risk management framework: development, implementation and use; validation; governance, policies and controls. Which element or responsibility belongs to which component.

selectors.name: Validation independence and effective challenge
selectors.what: Validation is done by people not responsible for development or use, with no stake in the result. Effective challenge rests on incentives (stronger with greater separation from development), competence and influence.

notSelected: ORR-15 a (definition of model risk and how it arises), ORR-15 c (best practices in development and implementation), ORR-16 a (defining a model and the ways of exposure), ORR-3 c (the ORX taxonomy placing model risk at Level 1) and the parts of ORR-15 d and ORR-16 b beyond independence and effective challenge (vendor models, internal audit, the MRM function and model tiering) carry no shape, no Map point and no Vardeez pointer.
